name: webrtc-mesh-vs-sfu
description: Project 23: WebRTC group calling — Mesh vs SFU bandwidth scaling

scripts.build:clients: npm run build -w @webrtc/mesh-client && npm run build -w @webrtc/sfu-client && npm run build -w @webrtc/dashboard-client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @webrtc/mesh-server && npm run test -w @webrtc/mesh-client && npm run test -w @webrtc/sfu-server && npm run test -w @webrtc/sfu-client && npm run test -w @webrtc/dashboard-server && npm run test -w @webrtc/dashboard-client && npm run test -w @webrtc/automation
scripts.test:dashboard: npm run test -w @webrtc/dashboard-server && npm run test -w @webrtc/dashboard-client
